response.justification: Bogdan is a broadly experienced senior/staff engineer with a genuine developer-tooling profile (LabWindows/CVI C IDE work at National Instruments, custom test runner and assertion libraries in D, MCP code generators, CI/CD infrastructure), which maps well to the 'developer experience' and tooling-mindset aspects of the role. However, the core hard requirements are not evidenced: Java appears only in passing (robotic arms, an in-house device orchestration tool, 2016–2018), Kotlin is absent entirely, and there is no exposure to Spring, Quarkus, Hibernate, application servers, or JVM internals. The last decade of work is predominantly TypeScript/Node.js and D. Retraining a strong generalist onto deep JVM/Spring tooling is possible, but this role expects existing depth, so the gap is too large for a mid-senior IC hire.
strengths: Rare hands-on experience building an IDE (LabWindows/CVI) and developer tooling
Proven library/framework author: test runner, assertion library, web server, code generators
Long track record on complex, performance-sensitive systems (millions of req/s at Sociomantic)
concerns: No Kotlin experience and no Spring/Quarkus/Hibernate exposure at all
Java is listed but only used peripherally, nearly a decade ago
Recent career trajectory is TypeScript/Node full-stack, not JVM systems work
